fields.description: Vida Residences Hillside brings one to three bedroom apartments and three bedroom townhouses to Dubai Hills Estate. The Vida-branded development combines private balconies with shared pools, fitness spaces and a multipurpose lounge. Its Hillside Park setting is a central part of the scheme, distinct from other Vida residences in the community.
amenities: Wider community golf, mall and park facilities

overview: The brochure places Vida Hillside alongside Hillside Park, whose proposed activity mix includes a putting green, rope course, skate and pump track, dog park and fitness spaces. These are neighbourhood facilities, with their own delivery and access arrangements. Inside the residences, the design direction centres on restrained colours and textured finishes rather than ornate detailing. A buyer’s useful comparison is the actual balcony, suite layout and outlook of a specific unit.
research.locationNote: The development is in Dubai Hills Estate, with Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Park and the golf club forming part of the wider community. The developer’s map relates the estate to Al Khail Road and Dubai’s main districts. Journey times and an individual home’s park view require a separate check.
research.priceNote: The official page currently displays units from AED 1,827,888. This is a published entry figure, not a quote or confirmation of available stock. The selected unit’s price and purchase terms must be reconfirmed.
research.paymentNote: The original schedule sets 80% before completion and 20% at estimated completion. Some listed dates have already passed. A current purchase or resale needs its own statement of paid and outstanding instalments.
research.handoverNote: May 2029 is the estimated construction-completion month on the branded payment sheet, also reported by Property Finder. The contract and current construction update determine the applicable handover position.

facts.label: Original collection
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 500 homes: 254 one bedroom, 166 two bedroom and 72 three bedroom apartments, plus eight three bedroom townhouses. These are launch totals, not remaining inventory.

facts.label: Launch price context
facts.value: The launch sheet lists entry prices of AED 1.82 million, AED 2.71 million and AED 3.88 million for one, two and three bedroom apartments, and AED 6.64 million for townhouses. These historical figures are not current offers.

facts.label: Area and townhouse layout
facts.value: Totals include balcony space. Townhouse suites measure 2,173.77–2,180.55 sq ft, with ground-floor living, kitchen, maid’s room and storage; three bedrooms sit upstairs. TH01–TH07 total 2,622.19 sq ft, while TH08 totals 2,616.48 sq ft.
